title: ui_text
summary: MSUI's GameTextLaw/GameText/FontObjectLaw retain the byte-derived 1.12 text metrics and named FrameXML font objects. UiTextMarkupLaw adds current build-5875 color/reset, escaped-pipe, line-break, and hyperlink parsing, carries shared link identity across metric wrapping, and feeds interactive chat color runs. Current Benilla's lower-level grammar proves that later-expansion |T...|t is not a token in 1.12.1 and therefore renders literally. FontStringOverflowLaw now owns the shared fixed-box greedy whitespace wrap, force break, render-ceil versus fit-floor line laws, min-one-line height clamp, scalar-safe backoff, and ASCII-three-dot marker; GameText exposes that law in logical FrameXML box units, and the authored fixed-size Who/Guild roster cells consume it without altering auto-height Friends strings or non-FontString text systems.

openItems.text: No inline markup parsing anywhere: |cAARRGGBB / |r color escapes are not resolved (server- or DBC-supplied colored strings, e.g. quality-color prefixes, would render as literal escape text), where Benilla's markup.rs splits lines into color runs with malformed-escape passthrough.
openItems.resolution: UiTextMarkupLaw resolves |cAARRGGBB and |r into colored runs using the enclosing FontString alpha, plus escaped pipes and all build-5875 line-break forms; chat renders the resulting per-run colors.

openItems.text: No |H...|h hyperlink support: item/player links in chat are neither styled, clickable, nor shift-click insertable (Benilla carries LinkInfo through every wrapped run).
openItems.resolution: The parser creates one shared LinkInfo per |H...|h...|h span and retains it through wrapping; the chat renderer uses that identity for clickable regions and ItemRef routing, including Shift insertion.

openItems.text: |T...|t inline-texture escapes are not stripped, so such a string would show raw markup instead of silently dropping the texture reference.
openItems.resolution: Adjudicated against current Benilla's byte-derived benilla-ui markup grammar and explicit tests: build 5875 has no |T token, so the sequence must render literally rather than be stripped. UiTextMarkupLaw implements that current behavior.

openItems.text: No general FontString overflow/ellipsize law (Benilla's layout/overflow.rs ellipsize_to_fit) - truncation behavior outside chat wrap is per-panel ad hoc.
openItems.resolution: FontStringOverflowLaw and GameText.EllipsizeToBox provide the shared build-5875 fixed-box implementation: whitespace-opportunity wrapping, overlong-word force breaks, distinct render/fit line laws, one-line height clamp, whole-scalar backoff, and the exact ASCII '...' marker. Fixed Who and Guild roster boxes use the API; auto-height and non-FontString systems remain outside its scope by design.
